CONVERSELY if SSIM jumps substantially toward the sibling band, the cap was pretrain-epochs and iter-4 keeps climbing. The diminishing 12->48 (+0.133) vs the still-large gap to 0.81/0.91 predicts the former (structural cap). (5) BUDGET: HARD 20-min train+score. Per-epoch ~4.86s over 200 stratified slices (from iter-1->iter-2 slope) -> 144 ep ~700s pretrain + ~112s fixed val+figure ~812s, comfortably under 1200s and the 30-min sbatch wall; max_train_s=1100 is the HARD backstop so train always leaves room for the 214-slice per-sample val + figure inside the wall. val_n=214 KEPT (NOT reduced), grad_clip=1.0 KEPT.
